sourceMethods: All 128 active subnet slots: current chain identities and all 128 SubnetRadar profiles.
100 dated September 4–5 SubnetRadar briefs, including the ecosystem channel; substantive claims cross-checked where public evidence was available.
148 public repository paths, including current and legacy mappings and the core Subtensor repository; 143 accessible, with paginated commit scans through September 5 at 9:32 AM ET.
128 dated indexed X searches by subnet name, with SN numbers included in later query batches; public project and profile feeds plus original X embed retrieval for surfaced posts.
Signed-in AlphaGap feed, market signals and Yanez detail page; its 48-hour summaries checked for old information, scope errors and unit mismatches.
TAO Daily, TAO Media, public Bittensor news and partner searches; Yanez customer page, Score founder post, Sentios pricing, Chrome Web Store and the original Chutes research paper.
Shizzy Unchained YouTube Videos and Live tabs; latest IDs and durations checked. No newer upload or stream was found.
Final chain-market snapshot at September 5, 9:32 AM ET. Displayed price moves are rolling 24-hour alpha prices relative to TAO, not USD returns.
accessGaps: Signed-in X search redirected to login, so a complete per-account X timeline scan and authenticated Grok research were unavailable. Indexed searches produced no relevant current results; this is an access/indexing gap, not evidence that every subnet was quiet.
Public feeds and embeds recover some X stories, but private, deleted, unindexed and video-only details can still be missed. Partner-side confirmation of the Score rollout was not located.

Discord discussions were reviewed through dated AI-generated briefs rather than authenticated original message history. Uncorroborated operational reports and metrics remain developing; relative dates were not treated as exact launch dates.

Five mapped repository paths returned 404: deprecated/deprecated, actual-computer/actual-subnet-95, Satori119/Satori, NIOME-BITTENSOR/NIOME and Oh-My-Ditto/ditto. Alternate accessible paths were scanned where found; organization pages are not complete repository inventories.

Catch-up items identify earlier event dates. Previously covered Chainlink/Forever Money and Trishool announcements are not presented as new September 5 announcements. Earlier dated editions remain unchanged.
No independently verified forward alpha-unlock calendar was available, so Unlock Watch is empty. Research coverage ends at 9:32 AM ET; later announcements fall into the next coverage window.

youtube.siteChange: Correct stream duration from 31:16 to 31:21; keep latest verified video IDs.

editorialDecisions.decision: Five-star lead. Verified customer/partner logos on company website; do not imply all names are paying customers or use the new proof product.
Five-star catch-up dated September 3 from original founder post. No global station count or enterprise-wide contract inferred.
Correct TAO Daily headline attribution: body says Bitsec SN60; do not assign Sentios to Bitcast SN93. Live product and pricing inspected.
Reject brief headline claiming emission resumption; body supports only a restart request.
Read current UMI repository: public calibration not started and translation weights inactive. Prior pivot retained as context.
Reject AlphaGap implication that new scoring is live; September 5 team brief says 0.6.1 held for validation.
Primary validation limited to isolated SN401 testnet, rewards disabled, no production changes, miner below baseline.
Final scan added v0.217.0 and default-off hosted admission API; do not claim general hosted release.
Original Chutes X update September 1, paper pre-existing. Publish dated catch-up rather than new paper release.

Current brief mentions three X links, math collaboration/event and Monday explainer without usable original URLs or a concrete confirmed event. No current repo commits. Keep as unresolved lead, not invented news.
Do not republish unverified ownership/fraud allegations or relative-time calls as new confirmed events. Latest YouTube interview is already on site.
AlphaGap 48-hour development story predates this window; no new commits in inspected paths. Avoid duplicate.
AlphaGap protocol/mesh story already covered; no new commits in inspected paths. Avoid duplicate.
SubnetRadar ecosystem channel is not an active subnet. Brief reviewed but excluded from 128-subnet roster.
Chainlink/Forever Money, Subtensor 454 and Trishool are in September 4 edition; only distinct new follow-up context included.
